_comment: SYNTHETIC. Every string, screenshot and wireframe here was written for this fixture.
It is what `decisions_build init --template compare` copies into a project so the
A-or-B board opens with something real-shaped to rule on. Replace it.

compares.question: How should the home page introduce the product?
compares.why: The headline is the first thing a new visitor reads, and today it names no feature.

optionA.summary: Slogan headline; the three features are named but not described.

optionB.summary: Plain headline plus one line on what each feature does.

secondOpinion.note: Name who it is for in the first line.

compares.question: How should visitors pick a plan?
compares.why: Choosing a plan takes two dialogs today, and the second one hides the billing period.

optionA.summary: A dialog with a second picker inside it.

optionB.summary: Three inline plan rows, one button each.

secondOpinion.note: Show the price on each row.

compares.question: Where should export live?
compares.why: People ask how to get their notes out, and nothing in the app answers.

optionA.summary: No export control anywhere in the app.

optionB.summary: An Export row in Settings that downloads every note as Markdown.
